outcome: Intraoperative challenges (difficulty in closing uterus, need for extra uterotonics, bladder injuries)
cohort: The study included 400 pregnant women with a history of one or more previous caesarean sections admitted to Bebe Nanki Hospital, Government Medical College, Amritsar.
finding: Repeat caesarean sections are associated with increased maternal (intraoperative challenges, postoperative complications) and neonatal morbidity (jaundice, prematurity, birth asphyxia), particularly in emergency settings and with multiple prior sections.
mod_finding: Repeat caesarean sections are associated with increased maternal and neonatal morbidity.
